programs.title: Counting Cars
programs.desc: US reality series following life at Count's Kustoms, a car customisation and restoration company in Las Vegas. Motorcycle lover Sharon has not been comfortable on a bike since she lost her leg, so Danny and the crew build her a bike for her and her partner that is safe, comfortable and cool.

programs.desc: The crew dishes out a full makeover on a '77 Bandit Trans Am. Along with a new paint job and a brand new interior, they fit spoilers, big tyres and a top class engine. Then, a '67 Chevelle returns for a supercharger engine.

programs.title: Tanked
programs.desc: Long Island medium Theresa Caputo asks Wayde and Brett to build her a mermaid tank and a koi pond.

programs.desc: This week Drew visits the home and newly acquired church of an antique dealer on the Scottish border, an architectural salvage business in a London suburb, and a village pub that sells antiques which double as the furnishings.
